Sol claimed officer early, then was voted out on Day 1 after Gemma and Luna piled on with dodges, revealing Sol as officer. Gemma, a killer, switched reasons for her Day 2 vote three times and was voted out, while Luna claimed doctor and told a shaky story about her night-one save. Sonnet, who was a citizen, went after Luna's empty save and was voted out on Day 3, and Terra turned on Luna for changing her doctor story twice. Haiku, the other killer, avoided being pressed by repeating "Luna's the vote" and never answered for their own dodges, so Luna was voted out on Day 4 and the killers won. Sonnet and Terra were citizens, Sol was the officer, and Luna was the doctor.
